failureClassification.detail: The new production message-counting probe initially failed to initialize the instrumented tab and then could not resolve its class from page.evaluate. Counter initialization now occurs in install(), and an explicit test-only page property exposes the counters. No production behavior was changed for those failures.

limits: Native broadcast delivery depends on contexts sharing the browser broadcast scope and database namespace. This does not bridge independent storage partitions or origins.
Raw IndexedDB writes outside the manager do not publish notifications. Explicit reads retain their persisted-authority checks.
Notifications carry only a commit marker. They do not transport or establish wallet identity, credentials or session state.
Browser channel unavailability retains local notifications and explicit authoritative reads; passive delivery then remains unavailable.
Full revocation/activation, reconnect and other supported-browser acceptance remain open. Worker loading, durable-presignature longevity, R171 migration and final R170 cleanup remain incomplete.
